Additional rules_ordeal notes:

- The oracle for any change is `cd examples && bazel test //...` passing on
  a real downloaded ordeal release binary — never claim the rules work
  without running it.
- `ordeal check` exits 0 for cleanly decided `sat` too; `ordeal_check` must
  gate on the verdict TEXT (`unsat`), never the exit code alone.
- `--cert-out` belongs to `ordeal verus` only; `ordeal check` takes no
  flags. Verify any new flag against the real binary before wiring it.
- Version hashes in `ordeal/extensions.bzl` are pinned from the release's
  `SHA256SUMS.txt` — never invent or leave them empty for known versions.
